idiomatic: On dingmao day, the prince was named Xu.

literal: On bingchen day, the detached commander of Gaoche Keluehan and others led more than one thousand seven hundred men to submit inward.
idiomatic: On bingchen day, the detached commander of Gaoche Keluehan and others led more than one thousand seven hundred men to submit inward.

idiomatic: In the tenth month of winter, on xinmao day, Prince of Zhongshan Yuan Ying died.

literal: On bingshen day, an edict stated: "We have borne the succession of Heaven and held the calendar for a full cycle, yet the Way falls short of the age of free tillage and teaching lags behind the age when punishments were set aside.
idiomatic: On bingshen day, an edict stated, "We have borne the succession of Heaven and held the calendar for a full cycle, yet the Way falls short of the age of free tillage and teaching lags behind the age when punishments were set aside.

idiomatic: As for the solitary and suffering illness of the people below, our heart constantly pities them; if we do not succor this, how is that the mind of parents to the people?"

idiomatic: Order the Court of Imperial Sacrifices to establish separately, in an open and spacious place, one lodge so that the sick within and without the capital districts may all be lodged there.

idiomatic: Strictly order the medical office to assign masters for treatment, examine their ability, and apply rewards and punishments.

idiomatic: Though years and span have their term and long and short are allotted by fate, yet the three illnesses differ [17] and some may rely on needle and stone; perhaps the words of Qin Yue and Bian Que may be tested in truth today.

idiomatic: Also, medical prescriptions are vast and spread widely; applying medicine to fit the illness is hard to exhaust in inquiry.

literal: Further order the relevant offices to gather all medical craftsmen, search the texts and distill them, striving to preserve essentials, take more than thirty scrolls, and distribute them to the nine domains; commanderies and counties are to copy them fully and send them down to townships so that people may know the arts of saving distress."
idiomatic: Further order the relevant offices to gather all medical craftsmen, search the texts and distill them, striving to preserve essentials, take more than thirty scrolls, and distribute them to the nine domains; commanderies and counties are to copy them fully and send them down to townships so that people may know the arts of saving distress."

idiomatic: From the second year of Zhengshi until now there has been no examination—merits and faults are hard to align; can there be no promotion and demotion?"

idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer an edict ordered that because of drought, all grain-eating livestock were to be cut off.

literal: On dingmao day, an edict stated: "The move of the capital to Song County is nearly two cycles; at the Tiger Enclosure the sounds of chanting are stilled and at the Four Gates the work of lecturing and reciting is cut off—the erudites sit upright, receiving empty salaries year after year; the noble scions sigh like Zijin; thinking on this quietly, We are doubly ashamed and indignant.
idiomatic: On dingmao day, an edict stated, "The move of the capital to Song County is nearly two cycles; at the Tiger Enclosure the sounds of chanting are stilled and at the Four Gates the work of lecturing and reciting is cut off—the erudites sit upright, receiving empty salaries year after year; the noble scions sigh like Zijin; thinking on this quietly, we are doubly ashamed and indignant.

idiomatic: Strictly order the relevant offices: the Directorate of Education is to be completed in mid-winter; the Imperial Academy and Four Gates are to be ready in late spring of next year."

idiomatic: On wuchen day, because of drought, an edict ordered the Ministry of State and the various offices to examine prison cases; an edict ordered the people of Hebei to go where grain was available in Yan and Heng provinces.

idiomatic: On dingchou day, because of drought the emperor reduced his meals and withdrew suspended music.

idiomatic: On guiwei day, an edict stated, "Sizhou suffered earthquake, collapse, and fissures; dead and wounded were very many; thinking on the destruction, our breast is sour with grief.

idiomatic: The dead cannot be pursued and recalled; the living who are ill should receive added medical rescue.

literal: Dispatch the Imperial Physician and bone-setting physicians and supply the medicines needed, going to treat them."
idiomatic: Dispatch the Imperial Physician and bone-setting physicians and supply the medicines needed, going to treat them."

idiomatic: On yiyou day, a great amnesty was proclaimed and the era name was changed.

idiomatic: An edict established the Hall for Settling Lawsuits and the Petition Cart, to exhaust the reasoning of the wronged and destitute.

idiomatic: In the fifth month, on xinmao day, Shule and Goryeo each sent envoys presenting tribute.

idiomatic: On bingwu day, an edict stated that households throughout the realm that had grain, beyond what was needed for the year, were all to lend to hungry people.

literal: From the second month there was no rain until this last day of the month.
idiomatic: From the second month there was no rain until this last day of the month.

idiomatic: In the sixth month, on renshen day, timely rain fell in great abundance.

idiomatic: On wuyin day, the prohibition on brood mares in Henan was lifted.

idiomatic: On jimao day, an edict stated, "Last year there was flood disaster; this spring scorching drought; the people are hungry and in distress and have nowhere to lodge their lives; though the silkworm month has passed, they cannot nurture the harvest.

literal: Now autumn levies are about to arrive and commanderies and counties are set on exacting collection; the Ministry of State is to strictly order the provinces to measure the people's property and clearly apply inspection to save extreme distress."
idiomatic: Now autumn levies are about to arrive and commanderies and counties are set on exacting collection; the Ministry of State is to strictly order the provinces to measure the people's property and clearly apply inspection to save extreme distress."

literal: On gengchen day, an edict released five hundred thousand hu of grain from the great storehouse to relieve hungry people in the capital and in provinces and commanderies.
idiomatic: On gengchen day, an edict released five hundred thousand hu of grain from the great storehouse to relieve hungry people in the capital and in provinces and commanderies.

idiomatic: In the seventh month of autumn, Tuyuhun and Khitan each sent envoys presenting tribute.

idiomatic: On dinghai day, the state of Wuji presented hardwood arrows.

idiomatic: That month, the Hephthalites, Khotan, Gaochang, Kumo Xi, and other states each sent envoys presenting tribute.

literal: Eleventh month, on bingshen day, an edict stated: "We have received Heaven's blessing and rule the imperial realm; the crown prince's person draws on numinous clarity and has just raised the palace of splendor; when the two luminaries are in accord the three goods are well joined—it is fitting that favor soak the whole realm and glory spread to all descendants.
idiomatic: In the eleventh month, on bingshen day, an edict stated, "We have received Heaven's blessing and rule the imperial realm; the crown prince's person draws on numinous clarity and has just raised the palace of splendor; when the two luminaries are in accord the three goods are well joined—it is fitting that favor soak the whole realm and glory spread to all descendants.

idiomatic: Grant throughout the realm one rank of nobility to those who are fathers and heirs; filial sons, obedient grandsons, honest husbands, and chaste wives are to be honored at their gates and lanes, with grain and silk given in measure."

idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on jisi day, an edict stated that governors and magistrates impeached by censors who met amnesty and were pardoned, and those whose examination fell in the middle grade, were all to be replaced.

idiomatic: The state of Goryeo sent envoys presenting tribute.
